archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Sophisticated Monochrome with Serif Display)
rationale: The user requested a premium, high-end agency feel. Transitioning from a generic dark mode to a sophisticated 'Old Money Tech / Editorial Future' aesthetic elevates the brand. We use deep warm obsidian as the base, champagne/sand for accents, and a classic serif paired with a crisp sans-serif to instantly communicate high-ticket luxury and authority.

rules.special: Use italic generously for emphasis in headings to create an editorial feel.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow components to breathe. Containers should have ample padding (p-10 to p-16).

radius.cards: rounded-none (Sharp corners for an architectural, serious feel)
radius.buttons: rounded-full (Pill shape for primary CTAs to create contrast with sharp cards)

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetrical Bento Grid for Services. Break standard 3-column symmetry by using col-span variations to create a dynamic, editorial layout.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned for most content to maintain reading flow, except for centered Hero and Section Titles where appropriate.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text colors must brighten explicitly. Borders change from #282522 to #C8AC82. Background surfaces slightly lighten.

framer_motion.entrance: Fade in and translate-y (10px). Slow stagger for lists.
framer_motion.parallax: Use subtle scroll-linked parallax for large images in the case study section.

motion_and_interactions.images: Grayscale by default (filter: grayscale(100%)), transitioning to color on hover. This adds a sophisticated, curated feel to the portfolio.

header.style: Crystal Glass navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0909]/60 border-b border-[#282522]).
header.logo: Uppercase, tracked out (tracking-[0.2em]), serif or clean sans.
header.links: Muted text transitioning to bone white on hover.

hero.style: Cinematic and deep. Use 'hero_background' image covered with a heavily blurred dark overlay (bg-black/60) and noise texture.
hero.h1: Large serif typography. Emphasize a word like *Customers* in italic.
hero.ctas: Primary: Champagne background, dark text, pill shape. Secondary: Outline, bone white text, pill shape.
hero.social_proof: Small avatar group next to monospace text '100+ HAPPY CLIENTS'.

marquee.trust_logos: Slow, continuous drift. Logos should be muted/grayscale (opacity-40), brightening on hover.
marquee.portfolio: Two rows moving in opposite directions. Cards should have no borders or a crisp 1px border. The tag should use the monospace font.

services_grid.layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Make it a bento box: Website Dev (col-span-2), Ecommerce (col-span-1), Landing Pages (col-span-1), Google Ads (col-span-2), Meta Ads (col-span-1), AI Automation (col-span-1).
services_grid.card_style: Solid #141211 background, 1px #282522 border. A sleek hover effect lifting the card slightly and illuminating the border.

comparison_section.style: Skip generic cards. Use a bold 2-column layout divided by a vertical line on desktop. Left (Traditional) is muted, struck-through, or low opacity. Right (Brandly) is bright, with champagne checkmarks.

how_it_works.style: Vertical timeline. Use massive transparent stroke-only numbers (01, 02) in Cormorant Garamond overlapping the step descriptions.

offer_pricing.style: Minimalist sharp-edged card with a glowing champagne top border. High contrast pricing typography.

audit_tool.style: Form inputs should look like minimalist terminal/editorial fields. No full background, just a bottom border (border-b border-[#282522] focus:border-[#C8AC82]). Use JetBrains Mono for the input text.

contact_form.style: Consistent with Audit tool. Submit button is a massive, full-width pill button.

faq.style: Minimalist accordion. No card backgrounds, just single 1px separating lines.

media.instruction: Use existing portfolio images as requested by the user, but apply the grayscale-to-color hover interaction. Never use placeholder images. If client logos are missing, use typography-based placeholders (e.g. text 'ACME CORP' in monospace).

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements, form fields, and navigation links MUST include data-testid attributes.
